tradeoffs.J01: SELECT: primary runtime-adjusted leader, mean IoU0.674658 at0.193s. tradeoffs.H02: SELECT: unchanged fast appearance-field comparator, IoU0.671889 at0.192s, small-region recall0.192574. It preserves regions that J01 loses, including the native BCSS53 tumour band and TIGER33 geometry. Its slight time advantage over J01 is not claimed as a stable speed improvement. Broad white clefts and false grey in BCSS60 remain; it is retained for complementary accuracy and an unchanged reference branch.
tradeoffs.C17: SELECT: unchanged exact palette-mixture inverse, IoU0.671604 at0.163s. The native BCSS45 and BCSS87 vessels avoid the fat islands seen in Gaussian discriminants, and BCSS60 avoids the false grey stripe. It gives a structurally different direct model with no learned colour classifier. It still fragments lymphocytic tissue in native BCSS74 and misses unrepresented coarse classes; small-region recall0.183608.
tradeoffs.J07: SELECT: expected Gaussian squared-hinge risk, IoU0.668524 at0.0753s,0.10996 percentage points above H10 with77 wins/67 losses/5 ties. Native BCSS87 removes H10's false fat island, offering a fast statistical branch. It loses more of the stromal wedge in native TIGER23, and its mean small recall0.197088 is below H10.25/149 optimizers return unsuccessful termination, maximum gradient infinity norm0.003051; these are finite-budget masks, not asserted converged optima.
tradeoffs.H10: SELECT: unchanged expected exponential Gaussian discriminant, IoU0.667425 at0.0613s, fastest retained method. It has higher small-region recall0.199198 and fewer unsuccessful optimizers8/149 than J07, despite a slightly lower aggregate IoU. Vessel-to-fat islands in native BCSS45/87 and excess red in TIGER37 remain. Keep as a transparent speed/accuracy comparator; no artificial bonus is awarded below one second.
tradeoffs.J02: REJECT: joint convex shared-nuisance field is fast0.1088s and small recall0.20368, but IoU0.667717 is0.4172 percentage points below H02. J07 has higher mean IoU and lower runtime. The restricted shared drift model has too large a class-specific regression despite a sound linear solve.
tradeoffs.J03: REJECT: harmonic exterior-glass probability is slower than H020.2282 versus0.1923s and slightly less accurate0.671798 versus0.671889. It changes100/149 case scores not at all, loses44 and gains only5 by tiny amounts. Native BCSS06 deletes additional annotated fat, while overview clefts remain filled across many BCSS cases. Its extra support deletion is fully penalized; it is not a demonstrated general white-cleft solution.
tradeoffs.J04: REJECT: posterior dominant-class integration yields IoU0.662780 at0.2494s, below C17 in both accuracy and speed. Finite Sobol importance quadrature remains approximate. Native/overview evidence gives no consistent gain in gland separation or small-region recovery; BCSS74 has false grey and BCSS60 remains sensitive to palette confusion.
tradeoffs.J05: REJECT: colour-graph fraction coupling yields IoU0.665982 at0.2587s, lower accuracy and slower than C17. Small recall0.183127 is also lower. tradeoffs.J06: REJECT: coarse-label log-fraction decoder gives IoU0.665271 at0.2094s, below C17. Small recall0.204917 increases, but overview BCSS25/26/41/63 and TIGER02 show extra speckles and false contour classes; an additional tiny region is not necessarily recovered anatomy. Its tile-label calibration distorts an already useful palette inverse.
tradeoffs.J08: REJECT: noise-subtracted quadratic class densities yield IoU0.656234 at0.0620s,1.1190 points below H10 with104 losses/41 wins. Native BCSS74 invents a broad grey necrosis band; native BCSS45 inserts fat inside a vessel. Native/pilot BCSS26 likewise confuses vessel and fat. New C++ kernel and exact thread parity are useful engineering evidence, not justification for a less accurate model.

tradeoffs.H04: REJECT: unchanged calibrated palette model gives IoU0.665594 at0.2576s, below C17 while slower. Native BCSS74 inserts grey necrosis/debris absent from the reference. Its child J11 slightly improves it, but neither reaches the retained palette or Gaussian methods; iterative calibration can distort a useful fixed conversion.
tradeoffs.J10: REJECT: proper rigid palette calibration gives IoU0.665690 at0.2595s. It preserves inter-endmember distances but barely improves H04 and remains below C17 with greater cost. Native BCSS45 retains vessel class, yet overview BCSS74/86 false grey and lower accuracy persist. Rigid calibration cannot explain the relevant conversion errors.

tradeoffs.J12: REJECT: propagated endmember covariance gives IoU0.665654 at0.2713s, almost unchanged from H04 and slower. The interior-Gaussian uncertainty ignores active endmember bounds. tradeoffs.C01: REJECT: unchanged tile-count likelihood gives IoU0.663706 at0.0851s.
